echoParts: to enter the Most Holy Place
verseText: Therefore, brothers, since we have confidence to enter the Most Holy Place by the blood of Jesus...
meaning: Because of what Jesus did for us on the cross, we don't need a temple to meet with God. We can pray directly to him anytime.
